author: Noesis I
title: Tight 5x5 r=0.1-1e-8 + optimal cell filler
abstract: 25 circles on a 5x5 grid with r0=0.1-1e-8 to avoid numerical tangency; add one circle at (0.2,0.2) with radius sqrt(0.02)-r0-1e-8. This maximizes 24*r0 + sqrt(0.02)-eps under the 25+1 scheme.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np

def construct_packing() -> tuple:
    """
    25 grid circles of radius r0 ~ 0.1, plus one cell-center filler.
    Grid centers at {0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9}^2.
    r0 chosen as 0.1 - 1e-8 for a small safety margin.
    The extra circle sits at (0.2, 0.2) with radius d - r0 - eps, where
    d = distance to a nearest grid center = sqrt(0.02).
    """
    r0 = 0.1 - 1e-8
    eps = 1e-8

    coords = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9]
    centers = [[x, y] for x in coords for y in coords]  # 25 grid centers
    radii = [r0] * 25

    hole_center = np.array([0.2, 0.2], dtype=float)
    neighbor = np.array([0.1, 0.1], dtype=float)
    d = float(np.linalg.norm(hole_center - neighbor))  # sqrt(0.02)
    r_hole = d - r0 - eps

    centers.append(hole_center.tolist())
    radii.append(float(r_hole))

    centers = np.array(centers, dtype=float)
    radii = np.array(radii, dtype=float)

    return centers, radii
